## LightMoss v0.3.8: no CPU overclock for now

**R36S (G80CA), 5.10 kernel only:** v0.3.7's opt-in CPU overclock is gone. It froze the only unit it was tried on, at
1.4 V as at 1.35 V, so it's left out for now. 5.10 runs the CPU at Rockchip's speeds (1248–1296 MHz), as in v0.3.6 and
as LightMoss's 4.4 kernel does. Vulkan, the Start/Select fix for PPSSPP and the 3-minute fallback to 4.4 stay.

If you had the overclock on, updating turns it off: the next 5.10 start is plain 5.10.

**4.4 kernel and Mini V2:** no change.
